title: Acquired Live at Radio City Music Hall (Presented by J.P. Morgan)
summary:
Hank Greenberg, who ran AIG, called me up and said, "You should come join us." I was thinking, "I'm going to go from Sandy Weill to you. I'd have to have my head examined to do something like that."

 I didn't know the AIG story. And the first thing you said was risk, and the culture around risk.
